harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Joined node1, node2, node3 into a single RabbitMQ 3.12.1 cluster, created a payments vhost with a durable quorum queue ("orders") replicated across all three nodes, and an app_user account scoped to that vhost for publish/consume. Verified durability by publishing 3 durable messages, stopping node1 (simulating node loss), confirming quorum re-election to node2 with no message loss, and consuming all 3 messages successfully from node3. Restored node1 and confirmed full cluster health. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time reboot protocol for all three nodes (native `reboot`, boot_id changed on each, RabbitMQ auto-started, cluster and quorum queue verified healthy after each), and did a final live publish/consume test post-restarts to confirm the app account still works end-to-end.
actions_performed: Installed Erlang + RabbitMQ 3.12.1 via apt on node2/node3; node1's apt mirror access was broken (network timeouts to archive.ubuntu.com), worked around by transferring the .deb packages from node2 via a temporary python http.server and dpkg -i on node1
Synced the Erlang cookie across all three nodes from node1's cookie
Joined node2 and node3 into rabbit@node1's cluster via rabbitmqctl join_cluster
Created the 'payments' vhost
Created app_user with generated random password, granted full configure/write/read permissions scoped to the payments vhost only, no admin/management tags
Declared a durable quorum queue 'orders' (x-quorum-initial-group-size=3) on payments vhost, replicated to all 3 nodes
Installed python3-pika on all nodes (via apt on node2/node3, transferred deb to node1) to run realistic AMQP publish/consume tests as app_user
Published 3 durable baseline messages, stopped node1's RabbitMQ to simulate node loss, confirmed quorum re-elected leader to node2 with all 3 messages intact, consumed them successfully from node3
Restarted node1 and confirmed full 3-node cluster recovery

Ran the mandatory node-restart protocol: captured boot_id baseline on all 3 nodes, rebooted node1/node2/node3 one at a time via native `reboot`, polled until reachable, confirmed changed boot_id on each, and verified RabbitMQ auto-started with full cluster/quorum health after each restart before moving to the next node
Ran a final live publish (node2) / consume (node1) test as app_user after all restarts to confirm end-to-end functionality
Cleaned up temporary guest vhost permissions granted only for initial admin-level queue declaration

evidence.summary: join_cluster output and final cluster_status show rabbit@node1, rabbit@node2, rabbit@node3 all listed as Disk Nodes and Running Nodes with no network partitions/alarms

evidence.requirement: payments vhost and app_user with publish/consume permissions created
evidence.summary: add_vhost payments, add_user app_user + set_permissions to '.*'/'.*'/'.*' on payments, and final list_permissions confirming app_user's scoped access with no admin tags

evidence.requirement: durable queue replicated across all nodes for failover
evidence.summary: quorum queue 'orders' declared durable with members on rabbit@node1, rabbit@node2, rabbit@node3

evidence.requirement: messages survive loss of one node and remain consumable from remaining nodes
evidence.summary: Published 3 durable messages (confirmed count=3), stopped node1's rabbitmq-server, confirmed queue still shows messages=3 with new leader rabbit@node2 and members including all 3 nodes, then successfully consumed all 3 messages from node3 as app_user

evidence.requirement: node1 restored and cluster returns to full health
evidence.summary: node1 rabbitmq-server restarted, cluster_status shows all 3 running nodes, queue healthy with 3 members

evidence.requirement: node1 restart: baseline boot id, restart ack, changed boot id, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 63f96994-..., reboot acknowledged, post-reboot boot_id changed to 54340e46-..., cluster_status and queue listing confirm RabbitMQ active with full 3-node cluster and quorum queue healthy

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: baseline boot id, restart ack, changed boot id, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 8d1d94e2-..., reboot acknowledged, post-reboot boot_id changed to 9438eef2-..., cluster_status and queue listing confirm RabbitMQ active with full 3-node cluster and quorum queue healthy

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: baseline boot id, restart ack, changed boot id, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id bfd05127-..., reboot acknowledged, post-reboot boot_id changed to 97429d43-..., cluster_status and queue listing confirm RabbitMQ active with full 3-node cluster and quorum queue healthy

evidence.requirement: app_user can publish and consume post-restart (functional end state)
evidence.summary: Published 2 messages from node2 as app_user, confirmed queue count=2, consumed both successfully from node1 as app_user after all three node restarts completed
